sections.title: Content plan
sections.sql: select name,dataset,type_name,variant,owner,due,review_due from content_week order by due nulls last,name

sections.title: Overdue and missing evidence
sections.sql: select name,owner,issue from attention order by name,issue

sections.title: Decisions and stale approvals
sections.sql: select name,dataset,owner,revision,decision,current_review,reviewer,review_due from review_queue order by name
